subject.title: Bug: 升级后 Dashboard 历史会话索引/映射错乱

question: What evidence and repair policy should OpenClaw require before relinking a Dashboard session key to a preserved transcript or trajectory file?
rationale: The code path gap is clear, but choosing a preserved file from corrupted state can expose or misattach private history, so automation should not choose the permanent recovery policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Require a redacted fixture first
options.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor or diagnostic repair.

options.title: Ship diagnostics before mutation
options.body: Add tooling that reports suspected mismatches and candidate orphan files without changing mappings until an operator confirms the recovery target.

options.title: Allow heuristic relink
options.body: Permit best-effort relinking from content, timestamp, or trajectory matches, accepting higher risk of attaching a Dashboard key to the wrong historical file.

recommendation.title: Require a redacted fixture first
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a redacted sessions.json plus transcript or trajectory fixture proves the wrong mapping and can drive a conservative doctor or diagnostic repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent session-state and migration history, and this decision is mainly about recovery policy for preserved transcript and trajectory identity.
